task: First step of the C5 card (21 November 2026): a pull request with the C5 protocol and the run matrix; a short trial for each AttackNet on fitting and dev only (arm B, fold 1, seed 42), with the check that every BN layer is re-estimated, the device, the time per epoch and the planned hours; configuration and evaluation code fixed before any new test result is examined. The comparison: AttackNetV1, AttackNetV2_1 and AttackNetV2_2 trained from scratch with the project implementations, 4 folds x 3 seeds (42, 43, 44) x 2 patiences (4 and 12) = 24 trainings each, 72 in all, 36 per patience; the 48 C2 checkpoints of LivenessNet and ResNet-18 reused; every checkpoint with ordinary BN and BN re-estimated on the fitting set only, at threshold 0.5 and at the EER threshold estimated on the dev of the fold in the same BN state.
authorisation: The C5 card asks for this pull request and for the three short trials as its first step; the trial is launched with --i-am-authorized from a clean committed tree after an independent review of code and texts. The 72 trainings start after the pull request with the command and configuration of the runs is published and its link is on the C5 card, unless the coordinator states otherwise on the card.

declarations.no_test: no test frame is assembled or evaluated and no test score or metric of the new trainings is read in this step; the only trainings are the 3-epoch trials on the fitting and dev frames of arm B, fold 1, seed 42
declarations.already_known: the NUAA test and the C2 results are already known (C2 evaluation 20261121-ARCHEVAL-332fbdf, pull request #32); the LivenessNet and ResNet-18 cells of this comparison are those cells, reused
declarations.not_independent: on NUAA this comparison is not an independent validation
declarations.post_hoc: the C5 design was written after the C2 contrast was seen (+9.98 points of ACER): a post hoc extension to three more networks
declarations.technical_trial: 3 epochs per network, patience 4, seed 42, NUAA arm B fold 1, fitting 1,400 and dev 400 frames; LivenessNet first as a control of the machine, not counted among the three trials
declarations.cpu_only: CPU only, GPU hidden and the remapping optimizer off (nuaa_folds_run.hide_gpu), as in C2
declarations.checkpoints: the three trial checkpoints are saved outside the repository, an unofficial output: only their names and SHA-256 enter the record
declarations.threads: 10 intra-op and 10 inter-op TensorFlow threads, set and read back by the runner (pad_arch_comparison.set_threads), as in C2

AttackNetV1.constructor: create_model(name, input_shape=(256, 256, 3)) with its defaults dropout_rate=0.5 and l2_reg=0.0

AttackNetV2_1.constructor: create_model(name, input_shape=(256, 256, 3)) with its defaults dropout_rate=0.5 and l2_reg=0.0

AttackNetV2_2.constructor: create_model(name, input_shape=(256, 256, 3)) with its defaults dropout_rate=0.5 and l2_reg=0.0

training.recipe: the training of the accepted run at patience 4, equal to nuaa_folds_run.FROZEN_TRAINING (legacy Adam lr 0.001 clipnorm 1.0, categorical cross-entropy with one-hot labels, balanced class weights, batch 16, at most 12 epochs, EarlyStopping on val_loss with restore_best_weights, ReduceLROnPlateau factor 0.5 patience 2 min_lr 1e-6, augmentation on the fitting set only, shuffle(4096, seed), seeds for random, numpy and TensorFlow), for both networks

threads.rule: requested by the coordinator on 19 November 2026: for the whole NUAA plan, intra-op and inter-op threads of TensorFlow at 10, set and recorded by the runner. Choice of the author: the values apply to every TensorFlow command of the NUAA plan, trainings and evaluations (our reading of 'the whole NUAA plan'); pad_arch_comparison.set_threads sets them with tf.config.threading.set_intra_op_parallelism_threads and set_inter_op_parallelism_threads right after TensorFlow is imported and before any TensorFlow operation, reads them back with the getters and fails if they differ or if TensorFlow was already initialised; nothing else of the threading is set by the runner; TF_NUM_INTRAOP_THREADS and TF_NUM_INTEROP_THREADS, if present, must equal these values (otherwise the command fails before any work); requested, effective, the environment variables found and os.cpu_count() are recorded

training.trainer: anet_trainer, a declared copy of pad_arch_comparison.trial_trainer with the substitutions ANET_TRAINER_SUBSTITUTIONS (restored epoch = the epoch of the smallest finite val_loss; non-finite history values written as null with the list of quantity and first epoch; the trainer saves no checkpoint); on finite histories it gives the card and weights of the original
training.non_finite_rule: rule (n), fixed before the runs, a choice of the author and a departure from C2, where a non-finite value in a new history ended the run as FAIL (here one network must not stop the trainings of the others): a non-finite value in the history does not stop the run; the quantity and the first non-finite epoch are recorded; if a finite val_loss exists, the restored epoch is that of the smallest finite val_loss and the checkpoint is saved and evaluated, provided every restored tensor is finite; otherwise the model is not evaluable (no checkpoint, no phase 2, no test); also not evaluable: non-finite scores or logits on the fitting or the dev in either BN state, or probabilities non-finite, outside [0, 1] or of the wrong shape in the timed inference pass (one message of the frozen C2 function, all counted as not evaluable), or non-finite re-estimated statistics; no new attempt with the same seed for a non-finite case

trial.control_rule: LivenessNet is trained first, with the same trainer, as a control of the machine and threads (not one of the three trials): the five quantities of epochs 1-3 must be identical, difference 0, to the accepted card arm_b_fold1_seed42 and to the C2 trial 20261119-ARCHTRIAL-b8f7cca, and the machine and versions equal, field by field, to those of the C2 trial (the rule of pad_arch_run.machine_rule, recorded); otherwise the outcome is CONTROL_FAILED
trial.after_outcome: pre-registered, a choice of the author: whatever the outcome (PASS, FAIL, CONTROL_FAILED, NOT_EVALUABLE, INCOMPLETE), it is reported on the C5 card before anything else; no new attempt changes the recipe, the constructor or the seed; an attempt in which the LivenessNet control was not reproduced or an AttackNet was not evaluable, as recorded in its status.json, trial.json or run.log, counts as CONTROL_FAILED or NOT_EVALUABLE whatever its final status, FAIL and INCOMPLETE included; after CONTROL_FAILED or NOT_EVALUABLE no new attempt and no run before the coordinator's reply; an INCOMPLETE is reported with its cause (cap or SIGUSR1) and step; otherwise a FAIL or INCOMPLETE is corrected in the code or the conditions, reported, and the trial repeated as a new attempt from a clean committed tree, the earlier record kept
trial.attempts: --attempt N must be 1 + the attempts found in the output and checkpoint roots (any date and commit); from the second the run id ends with -r<N>; attempt and earlier attempts with their status recorded in status.json and trial.json; the date of the run id is today's
trial.conditions_file: trial/conditions.txt (uptime, CPU usage, power mode, command, number of TF_NUM_ variables set, commit and number of lines of git status --short), written by the author around the trial, not by the runner
trial.cap_unit: minutes of wall time (elapsed real time, not CPU time)
trial.checkpoints: saved with pad_arch_run.save_checkpoint under --checkpoint-root/<run id>, a folder outside the repository, reloaded with nuaa_bn_recalibration.load_keras; only names and SHA-256 are recorded
trial.bn_check: five checks, one failed = FAIL: (1) the BatchNormalization layers read from the graph are the five of the registry, in the order of the re-estimation, with an admitted order on the graph and the moving statistics equal to all the non-trainable variables (544 or 448); (2) values per channel = frames x H x W of the registry (91,750,400 for bn1_1 and bn1_final, 22,937,600 for bn2_1 and bn2_final, 1,400 for bn_dense) and the channels of the registry; (3) every moving_mean and moving_variance changed and equal to the installed float32 values, every other tensor identical, the original unchanged; (4) consistency and softmax of the logits within the tolerances of PR #27; (5) finite statistics and dev scores different between the two BN states

plan.order: a choice of the author: six runs of 12 trainings, one process each, patience 4 then 12, in each AttackNetV1, AttackNetV2_1, AttackNetV2_2; in each run folds 1-4 and seeds 42, 43, 44; the trainer clears the session and resets the seeds before every model, a failure costs 12 trainings and not 36

caps.rule: a choice of the author: cap of a run = (largest estimate + (anomaly factor - 1) x the largest cost of one training) x multiplier, rounded up to a multiple of the rounding step; the anomaly factor covers one training at about three times its cost, as the first model of a C2 run (49.0 s per epoch against 14.4-16.3, 3.0-3.4 times)
caps.unit: hours of wall time (elapsed real time, not CPU time)

plan.machine_rule: every training and evaluation of the plan runs on the same machine with the same threads and versions as the official C5 trial, as in C2

reference.rule: the 48 C2 checkpoints of LivenessNet and ResNet-18 (runs 20261120-ARCHRUN-p4-7faa49f and 20261120-ARCHRUN-p12-ea7fdca) are not trained and not re-evaluated: their per-frame test scores already computed by the C2 evaluation are read, each file checked against the restricted SHA256SUMS whose SHA-256 is in the public status.json of that evaluation

plan.evaluation: the NUAA test is read once, by one C5 evaluation command published before it is run; the test frames of each fold are assembled once and scored by the evaluable new models of that fold in both BN states

definitions.decision: attack if score_attack > threshold (tie = bona fide)
definitions.eer_threshold: eer, the M1 protocol: candidates = distinct dev scores plus nextafter(min, -inf) if >= 0; attack if score > value (tie = bona fide); minimum of |fp * n_attack - fn * n_bona_fide| on integers, ties to the highest value

frame_ids.rule: per unit the networks present are scored on the same frame identifiers in the same order, also between the two BN states and between new and reused cells

primary.variation: per network and unit, ACER with re-estimated BN minus ACER with ordinary BN, as an exact fraction
primary.contrast: per AttackNet and unit, its variation minus the variation of LivenessNet, as an exact fraction, on the same 12 fold-seed pairs and the same subjects
primary.per_seed: the same values on the units of each seed, reported apart, outside the reading
primary.intervals: individual 95% intervals: no correction for multiplicity, no simultaneous coverage over the contrasts, variations or comparisons

AttackNetV1: ACER variation of AttackNetV1 minus that of LivenessNet lower than zero
ACER variation of AttackNetV1 minus that of LivenessNet higher than zero
AttackNetV2_1: ACER variation of AttackNetV2_1 minus that of LivenessNet lower than zero
ACER variation of AttackNetV2_1 minus that of LivenessNet higher than zero
AttackNetV2_2: ACER variation of AttackNetV2_2 minus that of LivenessNet lower than zero
ACER variation of AttackNetV2_2 minus that of LivenessNet higher than zero

definitions.presentation: percentage points = proportion x 100, rounded to two decimals half away from zero from the exact value, at presentation only; the computations use exact fractions
definitions.non_evaluable: rule (n): a model is not evaluable without a finite val_loss, with non-finite restored weights, non-finite scores or logits on the fitting or the dev in either BN state, or probabilities non-finite, outside [0, 1] or of the wrong shape in the timed inference pass (one message of the frozen C2 function, all counted as not evaluable), or non-finite re-estimated statistics
definitions.guardian: before the primary analysis: the effective threshold of every network 0.5 in both BN states, otherwise stop; LivenessNet and ResNet-18 with the 12 fold-seed combinations in both BN states, otherwise stop; an AttackNet with fewer than 12 pairs evaluable in both states: its variation, contrast and comparison with ResNet-18 not computed (k of 12 pairs), the other networks go on
definitions.descriptive_vs_resnet18: for each of LivenessNet and the three AttackNets, per BN state the difference metric(network) - metric(ResNet-18), and the variation of the network minus that of ResNet-18, with individual subject intervals; no reading
definitions.rankings: per condition the networks present in every unit ordered by mean ACER as exact fractions, ties with the same lowest rank, the others listed as not ranked; per unit the counts of the ranks; no interval
definitions.descriptive_conditions: the variations, contrasts and comparisons with ResNet-18 also at patience 12 with threshold 0.5 and at the EER threshold at both patiences, with their intervals and no reading; the rankings for each of the 8 conditions (pad_anet_definitions.descriptive_analysis); all three pairs of conditions are computed, a missing condition stops the evaluation
definitions.denominators: units, subjects, test frames summed over the units with attack and bona fide frames per fold and in total; the valid resamples reported with each interval
definitions.one_class: per model and BN state on the dev of its fold at threshold 0.5, the one-class rule of C2; on the test, as a descriptive count, the models that decide every frame one class, at threshold 0.5 and at the EER threshold of its fold, per BN state
definitions.reuse: LivenessNet = the 12 C2 models at patience 4 (and 12 at patience 12); ResNet-18 the same; their test scores are read from the C2 evaluation files, never recomputed

choices_of_the_author.constructors: a choice of the author: create_model with its defaults (dropout 0.5, no L2), the rule C2 applied to LivenessNet, not the values of model_configs.py
choices_of_the_author.livenessnet_control: a choice of the author: LivenessNet trained first in the trial as a control of the machine, not counted among the three trials
choices_of_the_author.six_runs: a choice of the author: six runs of 12 trainings instead of two of 36
choices_of_the_author.order: a choice of the author: patience 4 then 12; AttackNetV1, AttackNetV2_1, AttackNetV2_2; folds 1-4, seeds 42-44 in each run
choices_of_the_author.non_evaluable_rule: a choice of the author: rule (n) for non-finite trainings and not evaluable models
choices_of_the_author.guardian: a choice of the author: the per-network guardian, extending the guardian of C2 to the three AttackNets
choices_of_the_author.reading: a choice of the author: the reading of each contrast from its interval and the conclusions written before the test, one per AttackNet
choices_of_the_author.rankings: a choice of the author: the descriptive rankings of the five networks
choices_of_the_author.denominators: a choice of the author: the denominators reported with the table
choices_of_the_author.test_one_class: a choice of the author: the descriptive count of the models that decide every test frame one class
choices_of_the_author.percentage_points: a choice of the author: percentage points with two decimals in tables, figure and texts; exact fractions and full-precision proportions in the computations
choices_of_the_author.descriptive_vs_resnet18: a choice of the author: the descriptive comparison of the four networks with ResNet-18 in the form of definition (m)
choices_of_the_author.caps: a choice of the author: the cap rule of the runs with the anomaly factor
choices_of_the_author.trial_outcomes: a choice of the author: the outcomes CONTROL_FAILED and NOT_EVALUABLE of the trial, with their outputs written, and what follows each outcome
choices_of_the_author.reference_cells: a choice of the author: the public reference_cells.csv holds the name of each reused test score file and the anchor of the restricted SHA256SUMS, not the per-file SHA-256
choices_of_the_author.installed_copy: a choice of the author: the copy with the installed statistics must agree with the re-estimated copy within the tolerance of PR #27 (1e-5, no discordant decision)
choices_of_the_author.descriptive_conditions: a choice of the author: the descriptive conditions of definition (o)
choices_of_the_author.departure_from_c2: a choice of the author: rule (n) instead of the C2 rule, which ended the run as FAIL on a non-finite history
choices_of_the_author.attempts: a choice of the author: the attempt rule of the trial (--attempt N, run id -r<N>)

test: no test frame is assembled or evaluated and no test score or metric of the new trainings is read, computed or written. check-inputs and trial read what pad_arch_comparison.load_inputs reads (its TEST_READ: the five M2 manifests, the cache hashed whole with its label and subject members read, the extracted frames file loaded whole with the SHA-256 of every frame, the cells run, the folds run, the configurations, status.json and restricted SHA256SUMS of the two accepted LivenessNet runs and the card arm_b_fold1_seed42 of the run at patience 4; the fold schema is never loaded); in addition this configuration, the configuration of the pre-registration of C2, the configuration of PR #27 (for its tolerances and BN settings), the code files pinned here and the status.json and trial.json of the official C2 trial. check-inputs, trial, plan and check-plan read the public status.json and results.json of the C2 evaluation (published files; results.json holds the aggregated C2 test results, already known: it is parsed and only its list of the 48 checkpoints, with run, network, fold, seed and checkpoint SHA-256, is used); no restricted file of the C2 runs or of the C2 evaluation and no <model>_test_scores.csv is opened. trial, in addition: the image arrays of the cache, loaded whole into the frame store; of all the frames it assembles only the fitting and dev frames of arm B, fold 1 (an explicit check refuses any other role); it reads back its own checkpoints, written outside the repository. plan and check-plan read also, if given, the status.json and trial.json of a trial of this code
